instructions: Dry-run is the default. It may fetch immutable objects for ancestry checks but never pushes.
Execution requires --execute and a current main checkout.
Pin archive.commit only after root creates the immutable archive branch; a placeholder blocks execution.
Refresh expected_sha when a branch changes. A moved or missing ref is never deleted.
PR21/23/24 tips must be ancestors of the current remote main before removal.

For documents/tasks, tip ancestry in current main preserves original blobs in history. If ancestry is absent, every required transfer must match the current main blob exactly; main_path may point into an archival documentation folder.
The script protects main, every archive/ ref, Nika branches and all locally checked-out worktree branches. It rechecks local protection and effective push destinations immediately before each push.

Origin fetch and exactly one effective push URL must identify the expected GitHub owner/repository. Remote URLs and raw Git stderr are never printed. Existing Git authentication must already be configured.
